source.method: OpenStreetMap as drawn (API 0.6 map call, Oct 26 2026), filtered to the Azalea routing of a reversible nine: its 9 hole ways written twice (refs 1-9 and 10-18: an 18 here is the nine played twice; Magnolia's 9 ways left out), the 9 double greens the lines end in, bunkers, fairways (OSM's multipolygons with greens, bunkers and rough islands cut out), rough and ponds within 100 m of a hole line, woods within 120 m. Pars are the card's (GolfPass scorecard); OSM's agree on all 9. Made by scripts/bobbyjones/convert.py.
source.caveat: Not traced by hand: as accurate as OSM. No tee boxes: OSM has none here, so the hole line starts at one tee and the Longleaf tees (8 a hole) are not drawn. The Cupp Links short course's greens and bunkers (50-270 m off the Azalea lines) are left out. Tanyard Creek and its feeders are OSM waterway centrelines buffered 3.5 m each side (q osm+buffer, as at Creekside), so a ball read as water is a ball within ~4 m of the mapped centreline; Peachtree Creek is OSM's water area clipped to 100 m of a hole line (q osm+clip). No boundary: OSM's club outline (way 29354026, tagged closed for renovation) predates the 2018 rebuild and leaves the 9th green and the 1st tee outside it, so OB is off, as at Woodmont.
source.woods: USGS 3DEP lidar point cloud (GA_Statewide_B2_2018, s3://usgs-lidar-public): every 1 m cell whose highest return stands 3 m or more above the bare earth and holds high-vegetation points, within 75 m of a hole line, off the mapped turf, bunkers and water (scripts/lidar-trees/, D133).

imagery.release: Fulton County's Pictometry 2022 orthophoto (winter: dormant turf, bare trees), Fulton County GIS's public map service, one 512-px export per 256-px tile (~0.12 m on screen at level 19). No licence stated (P10, D140).

imageryEsri.release: World Imagery Wayback 2024-01-18 (release 41468; the same tiles through 2024-05-09), leaf-on, green turf, fairway and rough separate, short shadows: the Sep 2023 capture Bradshaw and Creekside fly (D125, D139). Picked Oct 26 2026 over 49059 (Apr 2026: dormant), 32553 (Aug 2024: dormant, hazy) and 47963 (Jun 2023: softer).

elevation.source: USGS 3DEP (elevation.nationalmap.gov 3DEPElevation ImageServer getSamples, bilinear; 1 m lidar where flown), via scripts/fetch-3dep.mjs

greenGrids.source: USGS 3DEP 1 m lidar (elevation.nationalmap.gov ImageServer getSamples, bilinear), via scripts/fetch-green-slopes.mjs
